headline: Kim Yo Jong says North will resume anti-Seoul propaganda loudspeaker broadcasts along whole DMZ 'within October'
dek: Kim Yo Jong, after inspecting border fortification work with Marshal Pak Jong Chon, announced North Korea will resume anti-South propaganda loudspeaker broadcasts 'within October' along the whole border; in a Thursday KCNA follow-up she said the North would place 'new counter means' on alert along…
sources: Kim Yo Jong statements carried by KCNA (Oct 21-22); AP (WHRO/NPR); Reuters; Al Jazeera; Arirang TV 'NEW DAY' report; ROK Defense Ministry spokesperson Jeong Bit-na (Oct 20: Seoul will take decisive action)
fault_line: Serious escalation signal or performative noise? Comments split between 'wasting electricity' dismissal and genuine fear of the mine-and-warning-shot tripwire.

sections.what_happened: Kim Yo Jong, after inspecting border fortification work with Marshal Pak Jong Chon, announced North Korea will resume anti-South propaganda loudspeaker broadcasts 'within October' along the whole border; in a Thursday KCNA follow-up she said the North would place 'new counter means' on alert along the border and have loudspeakers on 'standby' within days; 'tactical hunting teams are taking new positions.' Context: land-mine blasts injured 3 South Korean front-line soldiers; ROK/UN Command attribute the mines to North Korea, Pyongyang calls them legitimate defensive measures. She warned South Korean warning shots (meant to force DPRK soldiers back across the MDL) could provoke a severe response if they cause 'actual harm.' North continues adding mines, barbed wire, anti-tank barriers. Separately, unverified social-media claims that Kim Jong Un died of a cerebral haemorrhage circulate — NO independent verification (flagged as unsubstantiated by Tribune India).
sections.what_verified: AP, Reuters, Al Jazeera, Yonhap/ANI, Arirang agree on the KCNA statements and mine incident; death rumor has zero credible sourcing
sections.what_disputed: North frames mines/fortifications as legitimate defensive measures and says the border project reduces conflict risk; Seoul says it will respond proportionately
sections.why_matters: The Loudspeaker War: Kim Yo Jong puts psychological warfare back on the DMZ — 'tactical hunting teams' repositioning, loudspeakers live along the whole border 'within October,' mines already injured 3 ROK soldiers. Map the border, count the tripwires, mark the deadline: Oct 31.
sections.context: Background: Korea — NEW (Oct 21-22): Kim Yo Jong says North will resume anti-Seoul propaganda loudspeaker broadcasts along whole DMZ 'within October'; 'new counter means' on alert; land-mine blasts injured 3 ROK soldiers

totw_analysis: Our read: The Loudspeaker War: Kim Yo Jong puts psychological warfare back on the DMZ — 'tactical hunting teams' repositioning, loudspeakers live along the whole border 'within October,' mines already injured 3 ROK soldiers. Map the border, count the tripwires, mark the deadline: Oct 31. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Serious escalation signal or performative noise? Comments split between 'wasting electricity' dismissal and genuine fear of the mine-and-warning-shot tripwire.
